passages.text: Background. The ministry operates a regional registry of vehicles and operators.
The vendor shall migrate the existing registry database without loss of records.
The vendor must provide a test environment that mirrors production.
The vendor shall train at least twelve ministry staff before go-live.
The current system was introduced in 2012 and is hosted on premises.
User interfaces shall meet WCAG 2.1 level AA.
The vendor should provide documentation in English and in the national language.
The vendor shall make the system available to citizens through a public web portal.
Questions about this document must be sent to the contact person named on page one.
Personal data shall be processed only within the national territory.
The vendor must report any personal data breach to the ministry within 24 hours.
The vendor shall provide a maintenance window plan agreed in advance with the ministry.
The vendor must provide a maintenance window plan agreed in advance with the ministry.
Payment will be made within thirty days of an approved invoice.
The vendor shall deliver weekly progress reports during implementation.
